headline: Approved budget transfers and amendments for Electric, Water, and Sewer Divisions for FY 2025/2026
summary: The commission approved the Director's Report for July 2026 and several budget transfers between accounts in the Electric, Water, and Sewer Divisions for fiscal year 2025/2026. No members of the public attended or spoke.
decisions: Approved the Consent Agenda, including the August 4, 2026 meeting minutes.
Approved the Director's Report for the Month of July 2026.
Approved a Budget Transfer of $55,000.00 from Account 584 to Account 593 in the Electric Division for FY 2025/2026.
Approved transferring $11,000.00 from Account 364 and $10,000.00 from Account 367 (total $21,000.00) to Retained Earnings.
Approved transferring $21,000.00 from Retained Earnings to Account 925 (Admin. General Expenses - Injuries and Damages).
Approved a Water Division Budget Transfer of $85,050.00 for FY 2025/2026 to increase various wage and salary accounts.
Approved a Sewer Division Budget Transfer of $93,800.00 for FY 2025/2026 to increase various wage and salary accounts.

88 6. Discussion and Possible Action: Budget Amendment - Electric Division - FY 
89 202512026 - Account 925 - Administrative and General Expenses - [njuries and 
90 Damages 
91 
92 Ms. Dill stated that this is a two-part budget amendment where funds will come from capital 
93 accounts and go into the WED operating accounts by way of Retained Earnings . The WED is 
94 requesting a budget amendment seeking to appropriate $21,000.00 from Retained Eamings to 
95 Account 925 - Administrative and General Inquiries and Damages. Each year during the 
96 budgeting process, the WED works in conjunction with the Risk Management Department to 
97 develop estimates for workers ' compensation costs for the upcoming fiscal year. The WED uses 
98 historical data and the latest available information in developing these amounts. Once the 
99 workers ' compensation estimate is prepared the WED allocates that amount over the appropliate 
100 O&M and capital accounts. This allocation is based on the budgeted distribution of labor. This 
101 fiscal year (2025/2026) more work was performed in the O&M accounts than in the capital 
102 accounts. Since more work was incurred in the O&M accounts than budgeted and less work in 
103 the capital accounts than budgeted , there are funds available in the capital accounts to return to 
104 Retained Earnings . The WED is requesting to appropriate $11 ,000 .00 from Account 364 
105 Distribution Plant - Poles , Towers , and Fixtures and $10 ,000.00 from Account 367 Distribution 
106 Plant - Underground Conductors and Devices to Retained Earnings.
